Theme

Latin word

vernāculus

vernāculus, vernācula, vernāculum

adjective

local, native, home-grown (of produce, breeds and words); native, of the place

In this lexicon

  • local

    the recommended word · classical · Varr. LL 5.77: aquātilium vocābula partim sunt vernācula partim peregrīna (Lewis & Short); Col. 8.2.5: gallīnae (Lewis & Short); M-O s.v. local

  • regional

    also used · classical · Varr. LL 5.77: aquātilium vocābula partim sunt vernācula partim peregrīna (Lewis & Short); M-O s.v. local

Examples

  • nec vīcīna subest vīnum praebēre taberna quae possit tibi

    and there is no tavern nearby that could serve you wineHor. Ep. 1.14.24–25

    In the entry for local

  • vernācula: lactūca ā lacte, quod holus id habet lac

    native plants: lettuce, lactūca, from lac, milk, because the plant has milk in itVarr. LL 5.104

    In the entry for local
